standards.description: Make observations to provide evidence that energy is transferred via electric currents.
standards.traceDetail: Streaming dots movement and bulb brightness are observations of energy traveling in a loop.

standards.description: Understand that electric charge movement in a closed circuit constitutes a current.
standards.traceDetail: The battery-driven march of electrons through the loop is the charge movement of the standard.

standards.description: Use a macroscopic description to state that electric current in a circuit is the overall movement of charge.
standards.traceDetail: Current defined as charge passing points per amp and per coulomb.
